findings.details: The writer now wires the full admission recheck into beforePrepare under the shared owner lease, after target preimage checks and before snapshot/journal creation. The read-only probe also uses the shared lease. Runtime changed-after-preflight coverage remains blocked by preflight authority requirements.

The writer derives identity/role claims from authority records; the guard requires separately authenticated current role evidence with credential and grant bindings. The fixed registry is NOT_REGISTERED, and no resolver is present in this repository state. These record claims cannot authorize admission. A future registry status change alone would not supply the required evidence shape; a real resolver path must be registered and bound.

All four fixed owner, root, profile-registration, and apply-authorization record paths are absent in the live checkout. The application plan remains blocked pending currentness, selectors, the record chain, profile registration, and the final post-authority read set.

Writer catch logic distinguishes no journal/no new target effects from journal-present unknown partial effects and captures observed target hashes. The failure-injection/retry behavior was not executed because no authentic apply admission can reach the transaction.
